TERMINAL DELIGHT · OPS

Ops Overlay Glass

Every overlay backing now uses the left spine’s smoked, softened grid. Its foreground cards and groupings use the desktop-facing glass from Surfaces.

The grid stays beneath the cards

The first pass left sharp grids on overlay backings and flat fills on several card lists. Both now use the existing Ops material paths: the backing keeps its own grid, and the cards open through it.

The cards keep their glass faces

The artifact rail, attention queue, coordination findings, plugins, notifications and agent cards now share the foreground treatment. Text, controls and meaningful border colours paint above it.

Native checks

All nine native previews were inspected: artifacts, coordination, plugins, attention, graveyard, bug reporter, Surfaces, Agent Wall and notifications. Seven sampled backings have full opacity; their card faces have measured alpha between 0.72 and 0.77. The sample coordinates and method are recorded in the receipts.

All 2,722 local tests passed, with 15 existing tests ignored. The optimized build passed. The existing fullscreen, full-opacity and unavailable-compositor fallbacks remain in place. Release notes are updated.

The corrected build is ready for development integration. The main window has not been reloaded yet; its existing control-socket fault prevents the guard from checking unsaved document notes.
